The prosecution case, in a small compass, is that on 23-6-91 during Eid holidays PW 2 Ali Hossain (informant) came to his village at Char Hijull and heard that his second sister, accused Abala (since acquitted), who resided in the house of her husband, co-accused Falan, in the same village was living in illicit relationship with absconding condemned accused Kowsar, a close neighbour of her husband. On 25-6-91 (day after Eid-ul-Azah) at 8-30/9-00 PM PW 2 Ali Hossain along with his youngest sister's husband, PW 10 Nurul Islam, went to the house of their brother-in-law, accused Falan, when accused Kowsar went out of the dwelling but of Falan, at that time elder brother of PW 2, namely deceased Azahar Ali, aged 35 years was waiting in the nearby house of one Sama. Thereafter the informant (PW 2) called accused Falan out of his house to a point in the village road 20/25 yards south of his house and west of the house of PW 4 Bassu Mia. PW 2 informed accused Falan about the illicit relationship of his wife with accused Kowsar and requested him to restrain accused Kowsar from visiting his house, but accused Falan did not agree on the plea of a monetary transaction of Kowsar with him and his wife (Abala). At that time Bimala, daughter of Abala and Falan, came there and wanted to know what PW 2 was saying to her father but PW 2 pushed Bimala away to stop her from hearing the confidential talk between them. Bimala left the place weeping whereupon her mother, Abala, started to rebuke PW 2. At that time PW 2 started to go towards the house of Abala in order to calm her but at that moment accused Kowsar caught hold of his shirt and started inflicting fist blows on him. At the time of the scuffle between accused Kowsar and PW 2 Ali Hossain, accused Kowsar brought out a knife from his pocket and struck knife blows on his belly and chest On hearing the cry of PW 2, deceased Azahar Ali came there to rescue his younger brother. At that time accused Ruhul Amin, Asman, Omar Ali and Rafiqul Islam, who were standing there, started to beat Azahar Ali with lathis and iron rods and, as a result, Azahar Ali fell on the ground. At that moment accused Kowsar, leaving aside PW 2 Ali Hossain, sat on the body of Azahar Ali and dealt knife blow on the left chest and other parts of the body of Azahar Ali. Azahar Ali received serious bleeding injuries. On hearing noise and shouting, PW 3 Sobiron, a close neighbour of Falan and Abala, came there to resist accused Kowsar, but was herself dealt knife blows by accused Kowsar, who also delivered knife blows to PW 5 Solaiman, who was present there. Thereafter accused Ruhul Amin, Asman and Omar Ali struck lathi blows on the body of PW 2 and thereafter all the five accused persons left the place. On hearing cries, many people came there and saw victim Azahar Ali, who died within a few minutes. PW 2 lodged the FIR (Ext. 2) with PS Manikganj at about 10-35 PM. 

 11. The prosecution has examined the informant, namely, PW 2 Ali Hossain in support of their case. In his evidence PW 2 states that on 23-6-91 he came to his village home at char Hijuli during Eid holidays and heard that his sister, Abala, who lived in the house of her husband, Falan, in the same village used to maintain illicit relationship with accused Kowsar, a close neighbour of her husband. On 25-6-91 the day after Eid-ul-Azha, at about 8-30/9-00 PM PW 2 Ali Hossain along with his sister's husband, PW 10 Nurul Islam, went to the house of his brother-in-law, accused Falan. PW 2 states that on arrival in the house they found accused Kowsar going out of the dwelling but of Falan. At that time deceased Azahar Ali, aged about 35 years, who also accompanied them, was waiting in the neighboring house of one Samad. PW 2 called Falan from his but to a point in the village road, which is 20/25 yards south of his house and west of the house of PW 4 Banu Mia. PW 2 states that he requested Falan to restraian Kowsar from visiting their house because of illicit relationship between Abala and Kowsar. Falan declined his request on the ground that Kowsar borrowed money from him and his wife (Abala). At that moment Bimala, daughter of Falan, came there and wanted to know what PW 2 was saying to her father. At that moment PW 2 pushed Bimala and asked her to leave the place. Bimala started weeping and complained to her mother whereupon her mother started abusing her brother. At that moment accused Kowsar came to the place, caught hold of the shirt collar of PW 2 and started to deliver fist blows to him. There was scuffle between them when Kowsar brought out a knife from his pocket and struck knife blows on PW 2. On hearing the cry of PW 2 his elder brother, deceased Azahar Ali, rushed to the place in order to rescue his brother. At that moment accused Ruhul Amin, Asman, Omar Ali and Rafiqul Islam attacked Azahar Ali and assaulted him with lathis and iron rods as a result of which Azahar Ali fell on the ground. PW 2 states that leaving him aside, Kowsar sat up on the body of Azahar Ali and started inflicting knife blows on the left side of his chest causing serious bleeding injuries. PW 3 Sabiran, a neighbour, saw the assault on Azahar Ali by accused Kowsar.She was herself struck knife blows by Kowsar while she tried to intervene. PW 2 states that Azahar All died within a few moments. In cross-examination PW 2 states that the house of his sister's husband, Falan, is at a distance of 400/500 yards to the north of his house and that the house of Samand where Azahar Ali was waiting is at a distance of 30 yards from the place of the occurrence. He denies the defence suggestion about the land dispute with the accused persons He also denies the defence suggestion that he wanted to deliver a dagger blow to accused Kowsar which missed the target and accidently hit deceased Azahar Ali. To the cross-examination on behalf of absconding accused Kowsar, PW 2 states that it was a moon lit night and there was electric light at the corner of the dwelling but of his sister's husband Falan. He denies the defence suggestion that it was dark and cloudy night. 

 12. The prosecution case has received corroboration from PW 3 Sobiran, whose house is at a distance from 20/25 cubits to the north of the place of the occurrence. She states that she was taking her meals at 9-15 PM of the night when she heard some noise outside. At this she came out of the house towards the road and saw accused Kowsar delivering knife blows on the left side of the chest of deceased Azahar Ali. She saw the occurrence in the electric light. As soon as she tried to intervene, she was delivered a knife blow by Kowsar on her right arm (the injury was shown to the court). After sustaining the injury, PW 3 ran to the house out of panic. The cross-examination of this witness shows that there is a tank of accused Kowsar to the south of her house and that the bank of the tank collapsed damaging a portion of her lands. PW 3, however, denies that she did not get compensation from Kowsar or had a quarrel with him over fish. She denies the defence suggestion that there was no electricity in the place of the occurrence or that there was a heavy rainfall at that time of the occurrence. During her cross-examination she states that the moon was shining after the rainfall. 

 13. The other eye-witness examined by the prosecution is PW 10 Md. Nurul Islam, a sister's husband of the informant. He was on a visit to his father-in-law's house on the occasion of Eid-ul-Azha. PW 10 states that accompanied by PW 2 and deceased Azahar Ali, he left for the house of his brother-in-law, Falan, at 8-30/9-00 PM on the night of 25-6-91. Azahar Ali, however, was waiting in the house of one Samad, a neighbour of Falan. After the arrival of PW 2 and PW 10, Kowsar who was in the dwelling but of Falan, came out of the hut. Thereafter PW 2 and PW 10 went to the road by the side of the house of Falan, who was also taken there by PW 2. On the road they were talking with Falan about the illicit relationship between Abala and Kowsar. Falan, expressed his inability to do anything in the matter on the plea that Kowsar had borrowed money from him and his wife in connection with the irri project of their land. PW 10 has corroborated the evidence of PW 2 that accused Kowsar caught hold of PW 2 Ali Hossain, fisted him and brought out a knife from his pocket and delivered three blows to PW 2 with the knife. PW 10 has further corroborated the prosecution case that on hearing the cry of PW 2, deceased Azahar Ali rushed to the place of occurrence when accused-appellants Ruhul Amin, Asman, Rafiqul and Omar Ali assaulted him with lathis and shabols as a result of which Azahar Ali fell on the ground. Thereafter leaving aside PW 2 Ali Hossain, Kowsar sat on the body of Azahar Ali and delivered blows with his knife on the left chest and other parts of his body and he delivered five blows on his body (কাধে পিটে মোট ৫ (পাঁচটি) আঘাত করেছিল) PW 10 has further corroborated the evidence of PW 2 that on hearing the cry, PW 3 Sobiran came to the place of occurrence and tried to intervene whereupon she was also delivered a knife blow by accused Kowsar and that Azahar Ali expired from the injuries within a few moments. In cross-examination PW 10 states that Azahar died within 2/3 minutes and could not speak after the occurrence. After this statement we are not inclined to accept the evidence of PW 4 Banu Miah about a dying declaration being made by Azahar Ali before his death that accused Kowsar dealt a fatal blow to his chest. 

 16. We shall now discuss some of the points pressed in this reference and in the appeal on behalf of the absconding condemned accused and the appellants. Mr. Basaratul Moula has submitted that the FIR mentions that as soon as Azahar Ali came to the rescue of PW 2 Ali Hossain, accused Kowsar dealt fatal blow with a knife on the left side of the chest of Aiahar Ali and thereafter Ruhul Amin, Asman, Rafiqul and Omar Ali assaulted Azahar Ali with dangerous weapons. But the evidence of the eye-witnesses is that after Azahar Ali fell on the ground from the assault of accused Ruhul Amin, Asman, Rafiqul and Omar Ali, accused Kowsar sat on the chest of Azahar Ali and delivered knife blows on his body. We have considered the evidence of PW 4 PW 3 and PW 10, all of whom consistently have mentioned that after Azahar Ali fell on the ground from the blows delivered by the accused-appellants, condemned prisoner Kowsar sat on the chest of Azahar Ali and dealt knife blows on him. This is not a case of serious discrepancy in the evidence which prove the prosecution case. 

 18. Mr. Basaratul Moula has submitted that there could be no visibility at 9/9-30 PM of the night and that in the month of June it was rainy. In his cross-examination PW 2 states that there was an electric light in the corner of the house of Falan making it possible to recognize the accused persons and further that there was moon light. Similarly, PW 3 Sobiron supports the evidence of PW 2 that she could see the occurrence and recognize the accused persons in the electric light and denies the defence suggestion that there was no electricity or that there was a heavy rainfall. PW 3, in the course of her cross-examination, clearly mentions that the moon was shining after the rainfall. Similarly, PW 10 Nurul Islam in the course of his cross-examination states that there was electric light and also moon light at 9/9-15 PM of the night. Mr. Syed Abu Kowser, learned Assistant Attorney-General, has drawn our attention to the fact that the occurrence took place on the night following the Eid-ul-Azha and that on the 11th of Jilhaj the moon shines in the sky if there is no rainfall. Having regard to the evidence on record, we find that the trial Court was satisfied about the visibility from the electric light and the moon light making it possible for the witnesses to see the occurrence and recognise the accused persons. 

 28. Now about the penalty of death sentence awarded to absconding condemned accused Kowsar. The evidence on record patently shows that Kowsar not only caught hold of the collar of the shirt of PW 2 Ali Hossain and delivered him fist blows or knife blows, but he sat upon the body of Azahar Ali, who fell on the ground as a result of the assault with la this and iron rods by the four accused appellants, and then (Kowsar) delivered knife blows on the chest and other parts of the body of Azahar Ali causing bleeding injuries, the fatal injury being 10" (depth) on the left side of the chest wall, puncturing the pericardium and perforating the lungs from the left to the right.
